displayIdentity.body: Saul stands beside Stephen’s death. Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth. He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
